description: `useImperativeHandle(ref, () => handle, deps)` customizes what a parent receives in `ref.current`.
React 19 passes `ref` to function components as a regular prop, replacing `forwardRef`.
A small object of methods (`focus`, `play`, `scrollToTop`) exposed to the parent instead of a DOM node.
Pre-19 wrapper that let function components receive a ref as a second argument.
